hypotheses.evaluator: Uniform independent ordered four-root product conditioned on public reset; qualification and sampling strata do not restrict H.
hypotheses.family: Prior 648 full-behavior root types plus 8 direct input/not-input roots. Compatible reset DSL; exact complete-behavior deduplication.
hypotheses.sampling: One direct, one interaction, one delay-or-latch, one repetition root; sensor slots randomly permuted.

interfaces.A: Prior generic Active, complete ledger, legal catalogue and budget8, with common nonexhaustive-catalogue scope sentence.
interfaces.B: A plus pilot tested/untried bookkeeping and deterministic-reset fact; untried means known available unexecuted action only.
interfaces.O: B plus a fresh separate free JSON interpretation before every choice; only the current interpretation enters that step. Never retain prior interpretation, questions, confidence or preferred explanation.
interfaces.choice: Same legal-ID constrained decoder with all81 IDs including repeats always legal.
interfaces.fresh_interpretation_schema: See interface.py: four compact lists (at most one entry each), measurement-linked question object, and explicit OPEN_QUESTIONS / UNRESOLVED_BEYOND_CURRENT_DISCRIMINATION status.
interfaces.invalid_frontier: A complete invalid/truncated response is retained without retry and enters its own step verbatim marked unverified/schema-invalid; it has zero scored questions and fails the O all-schema gate. It does not invalidate otherwise authenticated B/A comparison.
interfaces.predictions: Identical authenticated ledger/query messages across A/B/O; no frontier or extra bookkeeping.
interfaces.schema_normalization: Empty/scalar prose strings canonicalize to empty/singleton arrays; a singleton question object canonicalizes to a singleton array. No semantic changes. Prose maximum512 characters, total generation384 tokens. All other fields and identifiers strictly validated.

limits: Compatible finite simulator cannot demonstrate genuinely unrestricted open-world discovery.
B bundles explicit reset fact and bookkeeping; common scope wording added to all arms.
O includes extra inference/compute as well as interpretation; a positive result does not isolate prose from extra compute.
Generated prose does not become authenticated truth. Measurement-linked question accounting covers only directly executable trace questions.
No O pilot or guaranteed O power.
Prediction remains a small set of144 endpoints per arm; exact capability claims remain limited.

question_accounting.broader_prose: May appear in limits/discrepancies; unscored for truth/resolution. No learned semantic judge.
question_accounting.comparison: O question-linked informative fraction must exceed B overall positive-information experiment fraction by5pp. B has no generated questions; this is an explicitly asymmetric behavioral benchmark, not a B question-resolution rate.
question_accounting.informative_followthrough: Immediate executed choice covers the named target and has positive independently evaluated realized information.
question_accounting.persistence: Same keyed question generated again with no intervening execution covering that target; descriptive evidence of repeated questioning, not proof of internal fixation.
question_accounting.resolution: Previously unobserved target trace answered by a later actual executed reset sequence having the target as a prefix, at or after that choice. No imagined/oracle answer receives resolution credit.
question_accounting.uncertainty: Report explicit unresolved status, finite H ambiguity and named-question ambiguity separately. Finite H corroboration is scoped, never proof of general open-world limits or a complete remaining-truth list.
question_accounting.unit: One independently model-chosen measurement question per step maximum; key is named legal probe sequence plus named sensor. Free prose is an unscored gloss, never treated as truth.

raw_first: commit rules before scientific world selection
commit raw manifest before any scientific scoring

statistics.area: Trapezoidal area of log2H from reset through every step0..8, divided by8; no interpolation omission.
statistics.bootstrap: 100000 paired world resamples, lower2.5 percentile, independent frozen seeds per comparison; queries never treated as independent worlds.
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni across B-A and O-B; each conjunction requires both exact paired sign tests and effect thresholds.
statistics.prediction: Exact count may not decline; bit accuracy must meet 2pp paired-world noninferiority margin. No powered exact-accuracy noninferiority claim.

technical_recovery: Never repeat a durable complete response. An incomplete technical request can resume identical frozen input/settings with authenticated attempt/interruption records, maximum3 attempts. No choice executes before response is durable. Corrupt/torn authentication stops for review.

world_admission.IDs: Shuffle81 legal sequences and assign P000..P080, matched across arms.
world_admission.direct: At least one singleton actuator changes a reset sensor; one actual direct input/not-input root also required by sampling.
world_admission.freshness: Exclude all earlier causal, active, triangulation and pilot scientific and engineering graphs plus new engineering graphs.
world_admission.modifier: A change in the second-action effect between B from reset and B after A, for some distinct A/B and sensor.
world_admission.oracle: Eight legal greedy-expected-information probes; at least six positive realized steps and eight bits; all three reserved traces identifiable.
world_admission.sealed: Three seeded distinct length3 patterns per candidate; all81 legal probes exclude them and cannot contain them as a prefix.
world_admission.temporal: AB versus BA endpoint difference, or AAA first versus third observation difference (identical current actuator bit, different history).
